questions.question: How did Job respond to his friends' claims to wisdom?
options: He left them all at once and flatly refused to speak
He wept aloud and would say nothing more
Sarcastically, that wisdom would die with them
He humbly agreed with all that they said
questions.answer: Sarcastically, that wisdom would die with them
